An aluminium box about 2.5 m by 0.7 m fixed to an old plaster facade. Deep maroon acrylic face, lettering in golden yellow: large Devanagari in a bold printed Hindi typeface "हीरा मोती ज्वेलर्स", under it smaller English capitals "HIRA MOTI JEWELLERS", and small in the corner "स्था. 1972". Photographed in daylight with the lights off. Wear: dust inside the face, the maroon faded at the top, a grey grime line along the bottom lip, a tangle of black wire running down beside the box. Frame: the board fills the whole width of the picture edge to edge, square to the camera with no perspective tilt, a thin strip of the wall it is fixed to visible above and below so the fixings show. Landscape 1536 x 1024. Spell every word exactly as written here, letter for letter, and add no other words; if a word cannot be written correctly, leave it out rather than invent letters. Photographic and true to life: not an illustration, not graphic design, not a render, not digital art, no vector look, no perfect symmetry, no logos, no real brand names, no people, no watermark.
